# AI by Faraz — Web Engineering & AI Solutions Studio

> AI by Faraz (https://aibyfaraz.com) is an independent full-stack web development and AI solutions studio founded and led by Faraz Ahmed. Specializing in high-performance Next.js & WordPress websites, Shopify & WooCommerce e-commerce stores, custom 24/7 RAG AI chatbots, autonomous AI agents, and CRM workflow automations.

## Core Services
- [AI Automation](https://aibyfaraz.com/services/ai-automation): End-to-end business workflow & CRM pipelines using n8n, Make, Zapier, Node.js, Python, and Webhooks.
- [AI Chatbots](https://aibyfaraz.com/services/ai-chatbots): Custom 24/7 RAG customer support and lead-qualification chatbots for websites and WhatsApp.
- [Website Development](https://aibyfaraz.com/services/website-development): Blazing-fast Next.js (TypeScript, Tailwind CSS) applications and custom WordPress platforms with 95+ Core Web Vitals.
- [AI Agents](https://aibyfaraz.com/services/ai-agents): Autonomous tool-calling AI agents integrated with business APIs, databases, and internal operations.
- [E-Commerce Solutions](https://aibyfaraz.com/services/ecommerce-solutions): High-converting Shopify and WooCommerce online stores with custom checkout UX and automated order flows.
- [Custom Software Development](https://aibyfaraz.com/services/custom-software-development): SaaS MVPs, client portals, analytics dashboards, and Supabase/PostgreSQL backends.
